subject: CTO hands-on: overnight handoff window and exec backup coordination

Cc: Peter Stevens <pmstevens@globexpartners.com>
Date: Mon, 4 Sep 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CTO session — need a tight overnight window for hands-on

Hi Neha,

Thanks again for the quick follow. Our CTO (and one of our platform leads) wants a hands-on demo that includes a short architecture Q+A and a walkthrough of the private deployment flow.

Key constraint: the CTO only has a 45–60 minute window that overlaps reasonably with EU and APAC execs — ideally a slot that isn't in the middle of their workday (their preference is late EU / late APAC local time). We know that's a tight ask.

Can your team propose 2–3 concrete meeting windows (with explicit local times for US/EU/APAC), and mark any DST edge cases? We can be flexible but would like an option that keeps at least one Redwood exec in-region (APAC) in case of live infra questions.

I can be the coordinator for Acme — looping Peter for scheduling details.

Thanks,
Alice Nguyen
Head of ML, Acme Corp
From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>

Cc: Peter Stevens <pmstevens@globexpartners.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 4 Sep 2028 12:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: CTO session — need a tight overnight window for hands-on

Hi Alice — thanks, this is helpful.

I spoke with the team and attached a slot matrix (slot_matrix.csv) that shows three concrete options with local time conversions and DST notes. Summary of the proposed options:

- Option 1 (minimal overnight): Tue Sep 12, 2028 — 02:00 PDT / 10:00 BST / 18:00 JST. This keeps the EU folks at a reasonable morning time and APAC in evening.
- Option 2 (APAC-friendly late): Wed Sep 13, 2028 — 05:00 PDT / 13:00 BST / 21:00 JST. Later for APAC but pushes into early US morning.
- Option 3 (split-handoff): Tue Sep 19, 2028 — 00:30 PDT / 08:30 BST / 16:30 JST. Slightly earlier for EU, earlier APAC afternoon.

Notes:
- US DST is in effect; times above are based on current DST offsets (we flagged potential Oct/Nov cutovers in the matrix).
- We recommend Option 1 or 3 if your CTO prefers minimal evening in APAC. Option 2 is better if APAC execs absolutely need a post-workday slot.

Can you confirm: (a) which option your CTO prefers, (b) whether the Acme platform lead will join, and (c) if we should plan for an APAC Redwood exec standby (Vivek) or a recorded deep-dive with live Q+A only.

Attaching: slot_matrix.csv (time conversions + DST notes). I will follow up with a calendar invite once we lock a slot.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Enterprise AE — Redwood Inference
neha@redwood.ai
From: Alice Nguyen <alice@acme-corp.com>

Date: Tue, 5 Sep 2028 08:40:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: CTO session — need a tight overnight window for hands-on

Neha — thanks for the options and the matrix. Quick answers:

- Our CTO prefers Option 1 (minimal overnight) but notes he can make Option 3 if we absolutely need to avoid an EU-morning start.
- The platform lead will join. They asked if we can keep the live demo to 40 minutes and reserve 20 minutes for technical Q+A.
- APAC coverage: we do want at least one Redwood exec in-region if possible (some of our infra questions are latency-specific).

One constraint: the APAC exec who's the ideal match for our questions (Peter from Globex is assisting with scheduling) can't do after 22:30 JST. If Option 1 puts the APAC person at 18:00 JST that works; Option 3 at 16:30 JST also works.

Looping Peter for calendar confirmation and to propose exact dates.

Thanks,
Alice
